title: Biography Flash: Warren Buffett Steps Back as Berkshire Enters a New Era
summary: In the past few days, Warren Buffett has completed the most consequential transition of his Berkshire Hathaway career. On September 18, Berkshire announced that Buffett was stepping down as chairman, becoming chairman emeritus while remaining a director. According to CNBC and Berkshire reporting carried by Reuters, his son Howard Buffett became non executive chairman, Greg Abel remains chief executive, and Susan Decker remains lead independent director.
